messages.subject: Trouble Modeling in Wallace
parts:
Hello Wallace team!

I have been having some trouble with modeling and visualizing in Wallace. Today, I was practicing using the platform with a tutorial that uses Tremarctos ornatus, and was following the directions on the vignette very closely. When I got to the Model module, I was successful in generating ENM's, but when I went to the Visualization module, and selected parameters to map the model, the screen went grey. 

For the visualization, I selected the model with the lowest AIC, and then selected Map Prediction, and the cloglog format with no threshold. 

Is there something I am missing? Perhaps a package in R that needs updating? Any help would be much appreciated!

All the very best,
